# eno.vn

> eno.vn is a verified classifieds marketplace for the international community in Vietnam — housing, motorbikes, electronics, furniture, jobs, services and moving sales. Listings auto-translate into 11 languages, sellers carry a public trust score, and contact happens in-app so phone numbers stay private.

## About

- Marketplace for expats and locals across Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi and Da Nang.
- Every listing shows price in VND, condition, location, and the seller's trust tier.
- Buyers browse and search without an account; messaging, offers, saving and posting require sign-in.

## Key pages

- [Home / search](https://eno.vn/): browse and filter all listings by category, brand, model, area and price.
- [Browse by brand](https://eno.vn/brands): listings grouped by brand with logos.
- [How it works](https://eno.vn/guide): buying, selling, trust and safe trading.
- [Help center](https://eno.vn/help): FAQ on accounts, messaging, offers and safety.
- [Safe trading](https://eno.vn/safety): tips for meeting, paying and avoiding scams.

## Categories

- [Vehicles](https://eno.vn/c/vehicles): motorbikes, scooters, bicycles, cars, e-bikes, parts.
- [Property](https://eno.vn/c/property): apartments, houses, rooms, serviced and short-term stays.
- [Electronics](https://eno.vn/c/electronics): phones, laptops, TVs, audio, cameras, gaming.
- [Furniture & Appliances](https://eno.vn/c/furniture-appliances): home furnishing and appliances.
- [Moving Sale](https://eno.vn/c/moving-sale): whole-home liquidations from people leaving Vietnam.
- [Fashion & Beauty](https://eno.vn/c/fashion-beauty), [Baby & Kids](https://eno.vn/c/baby-kids), [Hobbies, Sports & Books](https://eno.vn/c/hobbies-sports), [Jobs](https://eno.vn/c/jobs), [Services](https://eno.vn/c/services), [Pets](https://eno.vn/c/pets).

## Data feeds

- [Sitemap](https://eno.vn/sitemap.xml)
- [Google product feed](https://eno.vn/api/feeds/google-shopping)

## Notes

- Listing prices are in Vietnamese đồng (VND).
- Contact details are exchanged inside the in-app chat, never shown publicly on a listing.
